Forcing two edges to the same seed reads zero whether the distance is computed on the drawn curve or on the seed. [scenes.json sc_no_repeat.control; tree.json cords_never_repeat / cord_shape_variation_probe false_pass]; (4) The sc_four_looks control (two runs in the same look read the same) cannot rule out its stated alternative, looks differing only by tint. [scenes.json sc_four_looks.control/expect]; (5) The sc_spans control (the same capture with nothing under the span) is not a rejection or absence case. [scenes.json sc_fallen_span.control]; (9) floor.json says the walk establishes memory (heap and texture MB before and after) and save_size (mid-way and end). results.question: Which moment should be Gimme Some Slack's face, the one you judge it by first? (1) The workshop floor: a room of over-long cords looping across the floor, piling against the walls and plugging into a power strip at each junction, then one cord cut so its live end sparks and its dead end lies limp. (2) The yard of masts: a sagging line strung over a shed to a far mast, the mast knocked down so the wire lies sparking on the ground, a hauler shocked crossing it while the colonist sent to re-string it is safe. The other follows as showcase 2. Recommended: (1), the floor cords are what makes the mod.
